title: SREV-073 config publish rollback contract

private_node.description: Allocated CONF_SECTION or CONF_SETTING before publication

ordered_list.description: sections or settings ordered enumeration list

rollback.description: Local cleanup when allocation or map insertion fails

contracts: List_Insert_Before and List_Insert_After mutate the ordered list without a failure return
map_insert and map_append can fail and return NULL before a node is indexed
map insertion must succeed before the section or setting is inserted into the ordered list
failed string allocation releases already-owned local allocations before returning NULL
failed map insertion releases node-owned strings and node before returning NULL
Conf_Add_Sections or Conf_Add_Setting may return NULL only when no list-visible node was published
